quizzes.title: Technology basics
quizzes.description: Learn the foundations of processors, graphics, and connected devices.

questions.prompt: In processor technology, what is Arm?
questions.explanation: Arm is a company that designs processor architectures and licenses technology to other companies.

questions.prompt: What does Arm primarily offer to chip manufacturers?
questions.imageDescription: A processor based on Arm technology
questions.explanation: Arm develops instruction set architectures and processor designs that manufacturers can license.

questions.prompt: Which instruction set family is traditionally used by Intel desktop processors?
questions.explanation: Modern Intel desktop and laptop processors traditionally use the x86-64 instruction set family.

questions.prompt: Which company owns the SmartThings platform?
questions.explanation: Samsung acquired SmartThings in 2014 and operates it as its connected-device platform.

questions.prompt: What is a GPU designed to process efficiently?
questions.explanation: GPUs contain many processing units that work well on graphics and other highly parallel workloads.

questions.prompt: What does an arithmetic logic unit do inside a processor?
questions.explanation: The ALU performs arithmetic operations and logical comparisons used by processor instructions.
